paragraphs: Rav Chanina sent in R. Yochanan's name: Menachot 79b, near the end; Yevamot 58b. R. Yochanan was distressed that he could not ordain him; see Rav Oshaya. He was Rabbah's brother. Yuchasin writes “Rav Chanina in Rabbah's name”; I have not found this. Rav Chanina, in R. Chisda's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter 1 of Maaserot.
